 In case you missed it, the blurred lip trend is back, and everyone is doing what they can to get the look. Yes, there is a technique to it (more on that below), but there are also some makeup products you can invest in that do half of the work for you. As it turns out, what might look incredibly difficult to replicate can actually be easy with the right formulas.
 “The blurred lip is a softer, more effortless take on traditional lipstick ,” says makeup artist and leading educator at Sephora Shanzey Al-Amin . “Instead of a perfectly defined lip line, the color is diffused around the edges to create a subtle, cloud-like effect.” She adds that this trend was heavily inspired by Korean beauty and became popular because of its fresh and modern look that gives lips a fuller appearance without looking overdone.
 Still, with the market full of products promising the perfect blurred effect, I decided to dig deeper and chat more with Al-Amin, along with celebrity makeup artist Scott Barnes , to find out which ones are actually worth your hard-earned money. Check out their top products below!

 Powder Kiss Hazy Matte Lipstick - Brickthrough

 Our top pick for the perfect blurred lip is this low-effort, stunning MAC lipstick. "MAC Powder Kiss Lipstick has a soft, blurred matte finish right from the first swipe," says Al-Amin. "The formula almost does the work for you, making it one of the easiest lipsticks to create this look with."
 Pros: Buildable, highly pigmented
 Cons: None
 Product type: Lipstick
 Shades: 24
 Custom review: "The formula glides on smoothly, feels comfortable on the lips, and delivers rich, long-lasting color. I love how versatile the shade range is—there's truly something for every mood and occasion. It gives my lips a polished look without feeling heavy or drying, making it an easy staple in my makeup routine."
 Best Liner: Make Up For Ever Artist Color Pencil Long-Lasting Lip Liner
 MAKE UP FOR EVER 
 Artist Color Pencil Long-Lasting Lip Liner, Wherever Walnut Light 
 $26 SHOP NOW 
 If you're looking for a liner that can get the job done, look no further than this smooth formula. "This offers great options for lip liners, and they have over 14 truly neutral shades to match any lip tone," says Barnes. "Also, it’s a creamy, long-wear formula, so it doesn’t pull on the delicate skin of the lips."
 Pros: Long wear, two kinds of finish
 Cons: Some don't like the smell
 Product type: Lip liner
 Shades: 17 
 Custom review: "I was so surprised how good this is. I finally found the perfect cool tone shade, and it stayed on all day, even after eating! Great staying power."
 Best Splurge: Violette_FR Bisou Balm Sheer Matte Lipstick
 VIOLETTE_FR 
 Bisou Balm Sheer Matte Lipstick - Mon Cheri 
 $30 SHOP NOW 
 If you're willing to splurge, consider trying this sheer, lightweight balm from Violette FR. "This brand has incredible blurring balms that make it super easy to get this look," says Barnes. While it is on the pricey side, investing in a product that does the work for you is definitely worth it. 
 Pros: Functions like a treatment, sheer finish, lightweight
 Cons: Some find it drying
 Product type: Lipstick
 Shades: 8
 Custom review: "I’ve fallen in love with all Violette products! I have all of the colors of this line and love them all. Myrtille is my daily wear."
 Best Balm: Nyx Professional Makeup Smushy Matte Lip Balm
 NYX Professional Makeup 
 Smushy Matte Lip Balm - Snuggle Szn 
 $9 SHOP NOW 
 Any lip product that's also packed with softening ingredients is worth the money in my book. "The Nyx Smushy Matte Lip Balm is powered by shea butter, mochi rice powder, and sugar ceramides," says Barnes. Luckily, this buy is less than $10, making it one of the more affordable options on our list. 
 Pros: Pigmented, softening
 Cons: May need to be reapplied
 Product type: Balm
 Shades: 12
 Custom review: "I love NYX products and decided to try this out. I love how it blurs, and it's so creamy and soft on my lips. Great shades to choose from as well."
 Best Hybrid: Sephora Collection Cream Lip Stain 10hr Liquid Lipstick
 SEPHORA COLLECTION 
 Cream Lip Stain 10hr Liquid Lipstick - 01 Always Red 
 $16 SHOP NOW 
 In case you didn't know, the Sephora Collection has some solid products that I've been swearing by for years, so I'm not surprised this lipstick made our list. "This is one of my favorite products for this trend because it’s incredibly lightweight and easy to blend before it sets," says Al-Amin. "It gives you enough time to diffuse the color then wears comfortably for hours without feeling heavy."
 Pros: Pigmented, plenty of shades, strong staying power
 Cons: Some like the previous formula more
 Product type: Lipstick
 Shades: 51
 Custom review: The formula changed a little bit. It's now a bit more sheer but the stain power is still very good. Truly doesn't transfer. If you love a matte lippie, you'll love this!"
 Best Lip Stain: Fenty Beauty Poutsicle Hydrating Lip Stain
 FENTY BEAUTY by Rihanna 
 Poutsicle Hydrating Lip Stain - Berry Banger 
 $28 SHOP NOW 
 Fenty Beauty has become a staple at makeup stores for its high-quality formulas, and this product just adds to the brand's reputation. "Fenty Beauty Poutsicle Hydrating Lip Stain is a great option if you prefer a fresh, long-lasting stain," says Al-Amin. "It leaves behind a beautiful wash of color that looks very natural while still lasting throughout the day."
 Pros: Long-lasting, strong pigment
 Cons : Some say the tube leaks 
 Product type: Lip stain
 Shades: 4
 Custom review: "Not only is this super comfortable and hydrating but the color pay off is incredible and the stain is perfection! It's so long-lasting and really impressed me!"
 Best Budget: Sheglam Marshmallow Puff Lip Blur Pen
 Sheglam 
 Marshmallow Puff Lip Blur Pen-524 S'more Night 
 $6 SHOP NOW 
 If you're on a budget but still want a quality product that will give you the result you're looking for, try this Marshmallow Puff Lip Blur Pen from Sheglam. The triangle-shaped applicator aligns perfectly with the natural shape of your lips. Plus, it's available in 10 stunning shades. 
 Pros: Affordable, easy to apply
 Cons: Not as long-lasting as other formulas
 Product type: Pen
 Shades: 12
 Custom review: "My new favorite lip product. Such a good dupe but with a better applicator."
 What's the best way to achieve a blurry lip? 
 Once you have the product of your choice, there are a few simple steps needed to get a blurry lip. Here's the full breakdown.
 Exfoliate and prep: Smooth lips are the best place to start for any lip look. Barnes recommends gently exfoliating with something like NCLA's Sugar, Sugar 100% Natural Lip Scrub followed by a tried-and-true formula like Aquaphor's Lip Repair .
 Apply your product: Al-Amin suggests starting by applying lip color to the center of your lips rather than the entire area.
 Tap the color in: From there, use your fingertip or a small lip brush to blend the product outward to keep the edges soft.
 Build it up: After getting the technique down, feel free to build up the color to your preference.
 Add-on (optional): While this is not required, Al-Amin notes that you can layer on a gloss or balm if you don't want a fully matte finish.
